lines.text: Did you know? Vis is Latin for see.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus see?

words.ex: There is no evidence that the drug is harmful.
The school provides free lunches for all pupils.
I need to revise for my history exam.

publish.title: Vis root: evidence, provide and revise
publish.value: Vis comes from Latin "videre" (to see). Words: evidence, provide and revise. evidence = e + vid; provide = pro + vide; revise = re + vise.
